execution_conventions.atr_definition: Wilder ATR(14) on each mechanism's locked signal timeframe
execution_conventions.entry_atr_timestamp: latest fully completed signal bar available at fill
execution_conventions.alternative_exit_policy: replace all baseline strategy exits; retain hard flatten only
execution_conventions.trailing_update: completed signal bars wholly after entry; effective at next bar-open timestamp
execution_conventions.breakeven_update: threshold observed during a minute; stop change effective at the next minute open
execution_conventions.breakeven_price: filled entry price before exit slippage and commissions
execution_conventions.time_stop_execution: open of first minute at or after entry time plus max holding minutes
execution_conventions.missing_atr_policy: skip entry and record explicit check
execution_conventions.hard_flatten: unchanged frozen Topstep and early-close convention

robustness_rules.common_positive: Sharpe > 0 and PF > 1 and trade_count >= 20 in IS and Validation
robustness_rules.expectancy_preserved: expectancy >= 80 percent of the same mechanism baseline in both periods
robustness_rules.drawdown_improved: absolute max drawdown no greater than baseline in both periods
robustness_rules.robust_dd_expectancy_zone: contiguous common-positive cells satisfying expectancy_preserved and drawdown_improved
